 Jalen Williams underwhelming in loss Tuesday 
 by Leo Sells | Thunder Correspondent | Wed, Oct 21st 2026, 8:21am EDT 
 Jalen Williams scored 12 points (5-16 FG, 1-2 3PT. 1-2 FT) and grabbed seven rebounds in Tuesday night's 116-104 win over the San Antonio Spurs. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 The Thunder were able to pick up a nice win over the Spurs on Tuesday night, but Williams wasn't a strong contributor in that game. He was held to just 12 points on inefficient shooting splits, which significantly limited his fantasy total. He should bounce back and return to form sometime in the near future.
